reflection.assumptions: The pandemic may have influenced patients’ ability to access services, trust health institutions, navigate disruptions in care, and interpret public health messaging in light of prior outbreak experiences. I recognize now that my perspective may have led me to overlook the nuances of community referral systems and the varied perceptions of healthcare effectiveness among different populations. I also see that my focus on barriers to care may lead me to miss the broader social and emotional contexts in which these barriers exist.
